name: Quick Facedown
description: Two minutes, phone down, no stake. Finish and a sponsor pays a small reward.
steps: Start; your wallet signs in once (no stake)
Lay the phone face-down with FACEDOWN open (the screen goes dark)
When it buzzes, knock on the back (4 checks, one in every 30 s)
Switching apps or missing a check ends the session unverified
why: Most people won't put money at risk on day one (13.7% accepted deposits vs 90% rewards in Halpern et al., NEJM 2015). Free sessions let anyone start; staking is the upgrade.

name: Quick Facedown
description: Two minutes, phone down, one thing in mind. Stake 1 SKR: finish and get it back plus a bonus from the pool. Quit and it feeds the pool for everyone who finished.
steps: Stake and start; your wallet signs once
Lay the phone face-down with FACEDOWN open (the screen goes dark)
When it buzzes, knock on the back (4 checks, one in every 30 s)
Switching apps or missing a check forfeits the stake
why: Focus apps run on a local timer, so nobody can put money on them. PRESENCE times the session on the server, ties it to one Seeker, and checks for a human at unpredictable moments, so a stake can ride on it.

name: Facedown Hour
description: One hour, phone face-down: the evening or the first hour awake. Stake 5 SKR; finish for your stake plus up to 20% from the pool.
